cover.headline:
An operating system for
your next 20 people.
cover.lede: A fixed-scope plan to turn the Notion workspace you started into the place where a new teammate understands CozmicGo, knows what they own and can run a trip on their own. Based on our session on November 17.

glance.p: Ownership, SOPs and trip operations first.
Each one with acceptance criteria, in five weeks.
What to add next as the team grows.

context.title:
What we
heard.
context.lede: CozmicGo builds a curated women's community through shared travel experiences. Today you and Andrea host the trips and run the business. Over the next 12 months you plan to bring in hosts, marketing, sales and technology, most of them remote, and all of them needing to act without waiting for the two of you.

stats.t: teamspaces you already set up in Notion

context.pains_title: Three things to solve before the team grows.

pains.h: The business lives with two people
pains.it: "What they're responsible for and what they're accountable for."
pains.p: New hires need to see their role, their outcomes and how to do the work without asking a founder each time.

pains.h: Nobody to ask down the hall
pains.it: "A lot of our people are going to be all over the country."
pains.p: If the right information takes more than a couple of clicks to find, decisions wait for you.
Your pipeline sits in a spreadsheet, apart from the trips and the people who will work on them.

quote.text: We want to build for our next 20 people, not 200.

context.opportunity: You are about to make your first hires. Setting up roles, SOPs and trip operations now means every new teammate starts with clear ownership from day one, instead of learning the business by asking.

focus.title:
Where we'd
start.
focus.statement: A workspace where a new teammate understands CozmicGo, knows what they own, and can run a trip without asking the founders.
asked: An operating system for the whole company
Clear ownership and accountability for every teammate
A leads pipeline, today in Google Sheets
AI agents to create efficiencies, later on
recommend: A blueprint built on the teamspaces you already have
A company home with an onboarding path
A roles database: what each role owns and how it is measured
An SOP library your team can grow
Trip operations and your leads pipeline, connected
Training, then a roadmap for finance, marketing, technology and agents
focus.why: You asked what fits in a fixed fee of USD 2,500. Our recommendation is to build what your first hires will use every day, and leave finance, product and AI agents for the roadmap. A smaller system the team uses beats a complete one nobody opens.

proposal.title:
What we'll build
and what it costs.
proposal.intro: Each milestone has its own price and they add up to one fixed fee. Under each one you'll see the deliverables, the acceptance criteria tied to your three principles, and what we need from you.

phases.name: Discovery and blueprint
phases.summary: We learn how CozmicGo runs today, review the workspace you started and agree on the structure before building.

deliverables.p: A session with you and Andrea to walk through how a trip runs from first lead to follow-up, and which roles you plan to hire.
What to keep, change or remove in the teamspaces and pages you already created.
A document with the teamspaces, the databases and how they connect to each other.

items.q: You and Andrea approve the blueprint
Every database in it has a clear purpose and owner

you_do: Give us access to the workspace and your leads sheet

phases.name: Company home, roles and SOPs
phases.summary: The place a new teammate lands on day one: who CozmicGo is, what their role owns and how the work gets done.

deliverables.p: A home page for the whole team with an onboarding path for new hires.
Each role with what it is responsible for, the outcomes it is measured on and the SOPs it uses.
One database for every procedure and guide, with a template so all SOPs read the same way, organized by team and by role.
The first procedures written with you in a working session, so your team has a model to follow for the rest.

items.q: A new teammate finds their role and its SOPs in two clicks
Every role shows what it owns and how it is measured

you_do: Define the roles you plan to hire
Write the first SOPs with us

phases.name: Trip operations and pipeline
phases.summary: The core of the business in connected databases: your trips, the tasks behind each one and the leads that fill them.

deliverables.p: Each trip with its dates, host, status and everything related to it in one page.
The tasks behind every trip, each with an owner and a due date, created from a template when a new trip is added.
Your leads moved from Google Sheets into Notion, with stages and a link to the trip each lead is interested in.
One page for you and Andrea with upcoming trips, open tasks by owner and the state of the pipeline.
We show you the build halfway through and adjust it with your feedback.

items.q: One real trip runs in the system from lead to follow-up
Every trip task has an owner and a due date
You see trips, tasks and pipeline from one page

you_do: Load one real trip with us
Give feedback at the midpoint demo

phases.name: Training and handover
phases.summary: You and Andrea learn to run and grow the system yourselves, and leave with a plan for what comes next.

deliverables.p: A session with you and Andrea on using and extending the workspace. Recorded, so every new hire can watch it.
How the team uses the workspace day to day, written inside Notion.
What to add next and in what order as the team grows: finance, marketing, product and technology, and AI agents.

items.q: You create a new SOP and a new trip without our help
You have the recording, the guide and the roadmap

included: One working session with you every week
A shared channel for questions during the project
Sign-off with you at the end of each milestone
excluded: Finance, marketing and product and technology systems (ordered in the roadmap)
AI agents and integrations with other tools (defined in the roadmap, subject to technical feasibility)
Writing every SOP (your team writes them with the template, after the first ones we write together)
Ongoing support after the guarantee period
proposal.guarantee: Two weeks of async support after the last delivery to fix issues within the delivered scope, at no extra cost.

payment.schedule: 50% when you accept, 50% on delivery. By bank transfer.

next_steps.p: We send you the link to book the kickoff.
Five weeks from kickoff to handover.

closing:
We're ready to build
your Eureka moment.
